title: Chiral moments make chiral measures
summary: We develop a family of chiral measures to quantify the chirality of a distribution and assign it a handedness. Our measures are built using the tensorial moments of the distribution, which naturally encode its spatial character, not only via its angular shape consistently with existing multipolar-moment approaches, but also its radial dependence. We combine these tensorial moments into a rotationally-invariant pseudoscalar using a newly-defined cross product and triple product for arbitrary symmetric tensors.
